points.description: Names Sprinkler irrigation and Drip irrigation (both, by these technical names).
points.partial_credit: Only one of the two named correctly: 0.5 marks (only if no wrong items are listed).

points.description: Names Furrow method (furrow irrigation) and Flood method (flood irrigation) (both, by these technical names).
points.partial_credit: Only one of the two named correctly: 0.5 marks (only if no wrong items are listed).

rubric.notes: Full marks need all four methods named with the correct technical terms: sprinkler, drip, furrow, flood. Award 0.5 for a point only if exactly one of its two items is given precisely; vague descriptions (e.g. "water through pipes") earn nothing. A wrong extra item (not in the model answer) means the point it falls under earns nothing, so the marker should deduct from the point where the student's wrong item sits.
